summary: Attribute daemon background CPU and poll counts to static task names, buffer hot-task metrics, and label writer batch phases without losing individual submitters' accounting

schema.detail: CPU counters and task scopes are in memory only.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: OTel gains st.task.cpu_time in seconds and st.task.polls, both labeled by the bounded static st.task attribute. HTTP route instrumentation is unchanged.

downtime.detail: Only the usual daemon restart to install the build.

manual.detail: The counters use the existing OTel meter provider; no new configuration or dependency.

recovery.detail: The previous binary can be restored; no state is persisted.
